definitions.explanation: A ship designed primarily for transporting goods and materials rather than passengers.

examples.japanese: {貨物船|かもつせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: A cargo ship entered the port.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貨物船|かもつせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}んでいる→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: A large cargo ship is carrying freight.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{貨物船|かもつせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦コンテナ→コンテナ：09805_kontena⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧⟦{航路|こうろ}→航路：13972_kouro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: That cargo ship runs a regular route carrying containers from China to Japan.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{貨物|かもつ}→貨物：00165_kamotsu⟧ (cargo, freight) + ⟦{船|せん}→船：09875_sen⟧ (ship, vessel). Japan, as an island nation, depends heavily on maritime shipping, making this a commonly encountered word in news and daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{貨物船|かもつせん} — large cargo ship
- ⟦コンテナ→コンテナ：09805_kontena⟧{貨物船|かもつせん} — container ship
- {貨物船|かもつせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入港|にゅうこう}→入港：14771_nyuukou⟧ — entry of a cargo ship into port
- {貨物船|かもつせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ — cargo ship accident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{客船|きゃくせん}→客船：16792_kyakusen⟧ — passenger ship
- タンカー — tanker (ship for transporting liquid cargo)
- ⟦{漁船|ぎょせん}→漁船：22594_gyosen⟧ — fishing boat
- {輸送船|ゆそうせん} — transport ship (slightly more formal/military nuance)
